notes.title: MONSTERS OF KANJI - Steam guides
notes.notes:
Dear players,

MONSTERS OF KANJI might suprise you with its size. There are tons of hidden items to find and dozens of secret areas to discover. To help out a little bit I've been working on something special:

MONSTERS OF KANJI - quest guide
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1823708673

MONSTERS OF KANJI - secret area guide
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1827908470

These guides should help you a great deal if you ever find yourself looking for a specific secret or if you just want a hint on what to explore next.

Right now I am also working on two other guides: One for all of the MEM.DATs of the game, and another one for all of the DATA PADs that are needed to unlock kanji data for every monster. They're already available in a WORK IN PROGRESS-state, expect them to be finished in a couple of days.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1827946322

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1839494148

Thanks for supporting MONSTERS OF KANJI!

notes.title: MONSTERS OF KANJI / Update 1.1 / Release!
notes.notes:
Dear players,

I am happy to announce that "MONSTERS OF KANJI 1.1" is now online!

In the last weeks I spent a lot of time ironing out small typos and balance problems with the game. Steam Achievements and a world map have also already been added. And now it's time for the biggest addition to the game so far:

- Inside the ANCIENT ARCHIVE there are now 109 additional pictures that point out the stroke order of a lot ot kanji. That way you can do more than just review your knowledge. You can actually learn how to write many of the kanji. Still, I want to highlight this again: MONSTERS OF KANJI is in no way a substitute for proper Japanese lessons. The focus of this game are still its story and the exploration of its giant world.

Also part of the free update 1.1:

- Script improvement
- Enemy balance improvement

Of course, your savegame won't be affected by the update.

I will keep taking care of the Community Hub and if you have any questions, feel free to ask. Other than that, I hope you keep enjoying MONSTERS OF KANJI. Thanks a lot for your support!

notes.title: Steam Achievement Update!
notes.notes:
Dear players,

Finally, Steam achievements for MONSTERS OF KANJI are available. They unlock retroactive as soon as you go to the game's world map.

Some other small change that comes with this update:
The game won't start in Fullscreen anymore. To enter Fullscreen use F4.

Good luck getting all those achievements and thank you for playing! :)

notes.title: Launch-announcement / Post-launch support
notes.notes:
In a couple of hours MONSTERS OF KANJI will launch on Steam...

Thousands of hours invested in this beast of a project. Countless playthroughs to find every last bug. And still, I feel like there are so many areas where I want to improve the script, improve the balance, improve the visuals...And I will do that. But for now, it's time. 

The game will be out later today and I will support it via the community hub to answer questions, inquire about bugs (I want to say there aren't any, but let's be serious...) and read on your feedback. Thanks to everyone who's giving the game a go. I really hope you'll have a good time with it, whether you're interested in the japanese language or not.
